summary.overview: The project exposes a well-structured agent harness with progressive disclosure, CI quality gates, and delivery governance. However, the local pre-commit hook references non-existent npm scripts, session observability is absent, and learning capture has no observed episodes to validate effectiveness.

suggestions.title: Align pre-commit hook with existing package scripts
suggestions.reason: The local pre-commit hook calls lint:react and lint:types, but these scripts are not defined in package.json. The hook will fail or be bypassed, leaving local commits without the intended validation gate.
suggestions.nextStep: Either add lint:react and lint:types scripts to package.json that map to existing validation commands, or update the pre-commit hook to call the existing lint script.
suggestions.validation: Run git commit locally and confirm the pre-commit hook executes without missing-script errors.

suggestions.title: Exercise the learning capture loop on bounded tasks
suggestions.reason: Learning scripts are registered but zero episodes have been observed. Without exercised episodes, the learning system cannot demonstrate effectiveness or surface recurring patterns.
suggestions.owner: Task authors and goal-driven workflow users
suggestions.nextStep: Run npm run learn after completing one bounded goal to create an episode, then verify with npm run learn:status.
suggestions.validation: Confirm at least one episode record appears in .learnings/ and npm run learn:status reports it.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: AGENTS.md provides a concise portable entrypoint with commands, host layout, and behavior rules. Progressive disclosure routes into skills, specialists, and domain references. Multiple host adapters (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini) maintain consistent guidance.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Package scripts cover dev, build, test, lint, and goal-driven workflows. Agent OS hooks provide PreToolUse/PostToolUse interception. However, the local pre-commit hook references lint:react and lint:types scripts that do not exist in package.json.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: CI pipeline enforces git standards, lint, typecheck, tests, and build through a reusable quality-gate workflow. Artifact uploads provide failure diagnostics. Pre-commit and pre-push hooks chain local validation. No session-observed validation behavior confirms actual usage.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Delivery acceptance policy and recovery route are documented in AGENTS.md. Vercel rollback and promote commands are specified with SLA. However, no session evidence confirms delivery behavior, and the delivery-acceptance CI job depends on quality gate passage plus explicit acceptance recording.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: Learning scripts (learn, learn:status, learn:sync, ship:eval, ship:improve) are registered and executable. Active prevention self-test exists. However, zero episode records, zero recurring candidates, and zero scoped Skill observations indicate learning capture has not been exercised in the observed window.

findings.title: Pre-commit hook references non-existent npm scripts
findings.reason: The local pre-commit hook at .husky/pre-commit calls 'npm run lint:react' and 'npm run lint:types', but neither script is defined in package.json. This causes the hook to fail on every commit attempt or encourages bypassing it with SKIP_PRECOMMIT=1, removing the intended local validation gate.
expectedOutput: Pre-commit hook calls only scripts that exist in package.json
Local commits trigger the intended lint and typecheck validation
findings.aiFixPrompt:

findings.title: No session observability to validate agent behavior
findings.reason: Zero eligible sessions were analyzed. Without session data, claims about validation-after-edit behavior, edit habits, friction patterns, and delivery outcomes remain unverified. The harness provides the infrastructure (hooks, scripts, skills) but no observed evidence confirms actual agent-mediated work flows through it.
